purpose: Whole-knowledge-base public context brain. Selecting any place, event, dataset, issue or factor should activate related domains, sources, evidence, gaps and causal-hypothesis paths across the entire Irish public-data graph. It retrieves connected context; it does not assert official truth or causation.
